question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in ordered configuration-layer and immutable-runtime contract as the supported core V1?
rationale: The proposal creates new CLI/configuration surface and defines permanent authority and security semantics; correctness tests and lifecycle proof cannot decide whether core should own that contract.

options.title: Accept V1 after parity review
options.body: Approve the bounded startup-only contract after comparing the final RFC with the linked implementation, then complete the repository's accepted-RFC metadata and lifecycle steps.

options.title: Revise the authority contract
options.body: Keep the RFC in draft and request changes to precedence, policy-tightening, mutation, or validation semantics before accepting the direction.

options.title: Decline the core seam
options.body: Keep managed overlay composition outside OpenClaw core and close the RFC and linked implementation if maintainers do not want to support this contract.

recommendation.title: Accept V1 after parity review
recommendation.body: Approve the bounded startup-only contract after comparing the final RFC with the linked implementation, then complete the repository's accepted-RFC metadata and lifecycle steps.
